description: For a boat trip: a link that opens Headed In's Float plan with the route, crew, hours, leave time, safety gear and a note already filled in. The boater checks it and starts the trip in the app themselves.

leave_in_hours.description: 0 now, 1 or 2 hours from now, 12 tomorrow

route.description: Where they're going, e.g. John's Pass to Egmont Key (140 characters)
